subject: Re: GCP private offer — phased redemption schedule & co-sell handoff
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@orionanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionanalytics.com, GCP Partner Channel <gcp-partner@cloudchannel.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP private offer inquiry — phased redemption proposal

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orion is excited about Redwood for inference workloads. Procurement asked me to surface a couple of structured questions while we work through the private offer:

1) We prefer a phased redemption schedule across Q1/Q2 to match cloud budget windows. Can Redwood provide an example phasing that preserves co-sell eligibility and marketplace invoicing alignment?

2) Who owns the co-sell handoff (Redwood AM, GCP Partner, or us) when the private offer first gets activated? We want clarity so we can schedule the MVP migration and channel credits.

3) Any constraints on front-loading credits in month 1 (we may want a small ramp to cover proof-of-concept).

Attached is a high-level SOW and our procurement template. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Orion Analytics

Attachments: SOW-Orion-Redwood.pdf (pdf), PO-template-Orion.docx (docx)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, GCP Partner Channel <gcp-partner@cloudchannel.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer inquiry — phased redemption proposal

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear questions. Quick answers and a proposed path forward below. I included Ben (Marketplace) and Laura (Sales Ops) to confirm accounting and co-sell steps.

1) Phased redemption: we've sketched three phasing profiles that keep you in co-sell: a front-loaded (50/30/20), balanced (33/33/34), and ramp-up (10/40/50). Each profile maps to monthly invoice triggers we control via the private offer redemption ledger. See attached "redemption_phase_matrix.xlsx" for the exact month-by-month token/application credit allocations.

2) Co-sell handoff: Redwood AM (Marissa) owns the initial technical handoff and customer success onboarding; the partner channel supports co-sell enablement and will be looped for credits and marketplace co-sell reporting. Practically: Marissa leads the first 30 days, GCP Partner handles listing-side credits, and Ben will coordinate invoice metadata to preserve marketplace attribution.

3) Front-loading constraints: We can support a limited front-load (up to 25% of committed spend in month 1) without impacting co-sell eligibility, provided the PO & DocuSign indicate that allocation. More than 25% triggers finance review due to recognition and refund exposure.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to confirm invoicing cadence in HubSpot/Stripe mapping (Laura, can you confirm by EOD 12/22?).
- Ben will prepare the private-offer term sheet with the chosen phasing and marketplace attribution flags.
- Olivia, if you pick a profile from the spreadsheet we will draft the final private offer and DocuSign PO.

I've attached a cleaned term sheet draft (redemption-term-sheet-v2.pdf) for reference. If this looks good I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment call mid-week.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redemption_phase_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), redemption-term-sheet-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@orionanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionanalytics.com, GCP Partner Channel <gcp-partner@cloudchannel.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer inquiry — phased redemption proposal

Hi Rishi / team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the three profiles and we lean toward the balanced option (33/33/34) to simplify monthly recognition. A few clarifying asks before we sign:

• Can you add a single-line clause in the PO that ties marketplace attribution to the private offer ID so our cloud team can claim the co-sell credits?
• We need invoice dates to align with calendar month ends; will that work for your billing system?
• We'll accept the 25% front-load cap but would like the option to request a temporary bump during POC with a written exception.

Procurement has attached a filled PO template; we'll need a DocuSign-ready PO and the term sheet updated with the balanced phasing.

Olivia

Attachments: PO-Orion-filled.docx (docx)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, GCP Partner Channel <gcp-partner@cloudchannel.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer inquiry — phased redemption proposal

Thanks, Olivia — all sounds doable. Confirmations below and actions we completed:

• Attribution clause: Ben added a marketplace-attribution line to the term sheet that references the private offer ID and marketplace listing SKU. That will be included in the DocuSign PO.
• Invoice timing: Laura confirmed our billing system can align invoice dates to calendar month ends. She updated the invoice-mapping doc on the shared Drive.
• Front-load exceptions: We can approve temporary front-load increases for POC on a case-by-case basis; requests must be routed to finance with 5 business days lead time. We've added the exception language to the term sheet.

Actions:
- Ben uploaded the updated term sheet and prepared the DocuSign envelope (DocuSign: envelope-0a1b2c3d).
- Marissa will schedule the co-sell kickoff and CC GCP partner (meeting invite to follow).
- Laura will sync invoice metadata with partner channel this week.

Olivia — I attached the DocuSign-ready PO (DocuSign-PO-ORION-2026.pdf) in case procurement is ready; otherwise we'll wait for your sign-off on the balanced phasing.

Happy holidays — speak soon.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
